headline: MineHub arranges $1.5 million placement, pushes warrant expiry out to 2027
dek: The non-brokered financing prices units at $0.40 with $0.55 warrants, while more than 15.7 million existing warrants get an eleven-month extension.
caption: A dim server room corridor stands quiet as MineHub Technologies arranges a private placement to shore up working capital.

sources.title: MineHub Technologies Inc.: MineHub Announces Financing
MineHub Technologies Launches $1.5 Million Non-Brokered Private Placement and Extends Warrants to 2027

unverified_claims: The stated use of proceeds — working capital and 'continuing to evaluate strategic, corporate and financial opportunities' — and the insider-participation disclosure rest solely on the company's own release.
brief: MineHub Technologies Inc. (TSXV: MHUB) (OTCQB: MHUBF) has arranged a non-brokered private placement to raise up to CAD $1,500,000. The offering consists of up to 3,750,000 units at $0.40 each, with each unit made up of one common share and half of one warrant exercisable at $0.55 for two years from closing.

The company is also extending 15,760,417 previously issued warrants — exercisable at $0.40 and $0.50 — to a new expiry of December 31, 2027, from January 31, 2027. Certain insiders may participate in the placement, which is subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval and relies on exemptions from formal valuation and shareholder-approval requirements.

MineHub says the proceeds will go to working capital and to continue evaluating strategic, corporate and financial opportunities, as the Vancouver-based digital commodity supply chain company awaits exchange sign-off on the offering.
body: MineHub Technologies Inc. (TSXV: MHUB) (OTCQB: MHUBF) has arranged a non-brokered private placement to raise up to CAD $1,500,000. The offering consists of up to 3,750,000 units priced at $0.40 each. Each unit is made up of one common share and one-half of one transferable common share purchase warrant, with each whole warrant exercisable at $0.55 per common share for two years from the closing date.

A unit, in this structure, bundles a share together with the right to buy additional shares later at a fixed price — the warrant — giving subscribers upside if the stock trades above $0.55 before the warrant expires, without requiring them to pay for that right up front beyond the unit price.

Alongside the new placement, MineHub is extending the expiry of warrants it issued earlier. Prior warrants covering 14,584,954 shares at an exercise price of $0.40, issued January 31, 2024, along with 625,000 warrants at $0.50 issued July 25, 2025 and 550,463 warrants at $0.50 issued August 20, 2025, all had their expiry pushed from January 31, 2027 to December 31, 2027.

The company said certain insiders of MineHub may participate in the new placement, relying on exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements that would otherwise apply to insider participation under Multilateral Instrument 61-101.
Closing of the offering is subject to the company's receipt of TSX Venture Exchange approval, MineHub said. No closing date was given in the release.

MineHub said the proceeds are earmarked for working capital and for continuing to evaluate strategic, corporate and financial opportunities. The release gave no further detail on what those opportunities might involve.
